units.title: Surface embellishme nt through Embroidery
topics: 1.1. Embellishment on fabric/ garment with machine embroidery / Computerized machine embroidery
1.2. Embellishment on fabric/ garment with hand embroidery
uos: 1.a. Apply hand and computerised embroidery on fabric/ garment

units.title: Surface embellishme nt through Printing Technology
topics: 2.1. Embellishment on fabric/ garment with block, stencil, screen, painting etc.
2.2. Industry visit to observe functioning of digital printing, roller and heat transfer printing, and industrial screen printing
uos: 2.a. Apply different techniques of printing on fabric/ garment.
2.b. Explore and gain the knowledge of printing industry.

units.title: Surface development through fancy technique
topics: 3.1. Embellishment on fabric/ garment with Crochet- Single chain, slip stitch, single crochet, double crochet, treble, half single treble, double treble, triple treble etc.
3.2. Macramé- Half hitch, Half knot, Square knot, Lark head , Horizontal cording, Diagonal cording, Vertical cording, Overhead knot, Josephine knot
3.3. Tatting- single shuttle and double shuttle
3.4. Knitting- Purl, Knit, Garter, Rib, Cable and fancy stitch
uos: 3.a. Apply different techniques such as Crochet, macramé, Tatting and knitting for constructing accessories.
